## Kallisto Mapping to PalmDB + D-1. first

Here we take the cleaned reads and map them to the PalmDB + D-1. This will allow us to quantify the viral reads in the samples.

### Creating a Kallisto index for PalmDB 

```{bash, eval=FALSE}

# kb ref \
#     --aa \
#     --d-list /central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/Downloads/RefDBs/ref_genomes/T2T-CHM13v2.0_plusY/chm13v2.0.fa \
#     -i index.idx --workflow custom \
#     palmdb_rdrp_seqs.fa

# Creating an index for PalmDB + 
kb ref \
    --aa \
    -t 24 \
    --d-list /central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/Downloads/RefDBs/ref_genomes/GRCh38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna_dna.fa.gz \
    -i index_GRCh38_PalmDB.idx --workflow custom \
    palmdb_rdrp_seqs.fa

```

Sample of running Kallisto Count (option #1)

```{bash, eval=FALSE}

kb count \
    -t 24 \
    -o /central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/PDMBS/workflow/RNASEQ/test_palmdb_bwa_dlist \
    --aa \
    -m 4G \
    -i index_GRCh38_PalmDB.idx \
    -g palmdb_clustered_t2g.txt \
    --parity paired \
    -x BULK \
    --matrix-to-files \
    /central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/PDMBS/workflow/RNASEQ/clean_reads/PP-40737-BLM0T1_R1.fastq.gz \
    /central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/PDMBS/workflow/RNASEQ/clean_reads/PP-40737-BLM0T1_R2.fastq.gz


# "--batch-barcodes batch.txt"
# Also can create h5ad file

```

### Running Kallisto at scale with R

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Run Kallisto on PalmDB
run_kallisto_palmdb <- function(fwd, rev, threads, output_dir, wkdir) {
    require(glue)
    source(glue("{wkdir}/notebooks/R_scripts/_misc_functions.R"))
    palmdb <- "/central/groups/MazmanianLab/joeB/Downloads/RefDBs/PalmDB"
    cmd <- glue(
        "mamba run -n kallisto_env ",
        "kb count",
        " -t {threads}",
        " -o {output_dir}",
        " -m 4G",
        " -i {palmdb}/index.idx",
        " -g {palmdb}/palmdb_clustered_t2g.txt",
        " -x BULK",
        " --aa",
        " --parity paired",
        " --matrix-to-files",
        " {fwd} {rev}"
    )
    print(cmd)
    shell_do(cmd)
}


fq_paths <- list.files(
    glue("{pdmbs_dir}/workflow/RNASEQ/clean_reads"),
    pattern = "fastq.gz",
    full.names = TRUE
    ) %>% 
    data.frame("fq_path" = .) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = basename(fq_path) %>% strex::str_before_last("_")) %>%
    mutate(annot = case_when(
        grepl("_R1.fastq.gz", fq_path) ~ "fwd",
        grepl("_R2.fastq.gz", fq_path) ~ "rev",
        TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = annot, values_from = fq_path)

# Run Kallisto on PalmDB
batchtools_params <- fq_paths %>%
    # calculate f1 size in MB
    mutate(f1_size = file.size(fwd) / 1e6) %>%
    # filter for files larger than 100MB (all other files are empty)
    filter(f1_size >= 100) %>%
    mutate(
        threads = 4,
        output_dir = glue(
            "{pdmbs_dir}/workflow/RNASEQ/palmdb_bwa_dlist/{sample_id}"
            ),
        wkdir = wkdir
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(sample_id, f1_size)) %>% 
    glimpse()

# configure registry ----
cluster_run <- glue("{get_time()}_Kallisto_PalmDB")
message("\n\nRUNNING:  ", cluster_run, "\n")
breg <- makeRegistry(
  file.dir = glue(
    "{wkdir}/.cluster_runs/",
    cluster_run
  ),
  seed = 42
)
breg$cluster.functions <- batchtools::makeClusterFunctionsSlurm(
  template = glue("{wkdir}/batchtools_templates/batchtools.slurm.tmpl"),
  scheduler.latency = 0.1,
  fs.latency = 1
)
# Submit Jobs ----
jobs <- batchMap(
  fun = run_kallisto_palmdb,
  args = batchtools_params,
  reg = breg
)
# jobs[, chunk := chunk(job.id, chunk.size = 1)]
# print(jobs[, .N, by = chunk])

submitJobs(jobs,
    resources = list(
        walltime = 3600, # sec
        memory = 32000, # MB
        ncpus = 8,
        max.concurrent.jobs = 9999
    )
)

```


## Assessing Read Concordance and Distribution
### Aggregating individual sample counts

```{r, eval=FALSE}

sample_id <- list.dirs(palmddb_res, recursive = FALSE) %>%
    basename()

convert_dgCMatrix_to_tidy <- function(fwd_counts, rev_counts) {
    tidy_df <-
        data.frame(
            virus_ids = names(fwd_counts),
            forward_reads = fwd_counts,
            reverse_reads = rev_counts
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(forward_reads > 0 | reverse_reads > 0)
    return(tidy_df)
}

progress_bar <- progress::progress_bar$new(
    format = "  :spin [:bar] :percent eta: :eta",
    total = length(sample_id)
)

palm_res <- tibble()

for (id in sample_id) {
    results_path <- glue("{palmddb_res}/{id}/counts_unfiltered")
    progress_bar$tick()
    gene_list_path <- glue("{results_path}/cells_x_genes.genes.names.txt")
    mtx_path = glue("{results_path}/cells_x_genes.mtx")

    feature.names <- read.table(
        file = gene_list_path,
        header = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = NULL, skip = 0
    )

    mtx <- readMM(mtx_path)
    dense_mat <- as.matrix(mtx)
    colnames(dense_mat) <- feature.names$V1

    sample_df <- convert_dgCMatrix_to_tidy(dense_mat[1, ], dense_mat[2, ]) %>%
        mutate(sample_id = id)
    palm_res %<>% bind_rows(sample_df)
}

# Save forward and reverse read counts
saveRDS(
    palm_res,
    glue(
        "{palm_interim}/",
        "fwd-rev-counts_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

```


### Visualizing concordance between forward and reverse reads

```{r, eval=FALSE}

palm_res <- readRDS(
    glue(
        "{palm_interim}/",
        "fwd-rev-counts_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_2024-07-04.rds"
    )
)

# read in virus metadata
palm_meta <- read.csv(
    glue("{palmdb_data}/ID_to_taxonomy_mapping.csv"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
    dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    glimpse()


fwd_rev_stats <- palm_res %>%
    group_by(virus_ids) %>%
    dplyr::reframe(
        forward_reads = sum(forward_reads),
        reverse_reads = sum(reverse_reads),
        prevalence_n = n()
    ) %>%
    left_join(palm_meta, by = c("virus_ids" = "rep_ID")) %>% 
    glimpse()


stand_colors <- c(pal_d3("category10")(8))
names(stand_colors) <- sort(unique(fwd_rev_stats$strandedness))

strand_alpha <- c(rep(0.7, 7), 0.1)
names(strand_alpha) <- names(stand_colors)

# Summated viral counts across all samples and plotting
# scatter of fwd/rev reads
p_fwdrev_spread <- fwd_rev_stats %>%
    mutate(not_unk = ifelse(strandedness == "unknown", 0, 1)) %>%
    arrange(not_unk) %>%
    mutate(virus_ids = factor(virus_ids, levels = unique(virus_ids))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reverse_reads + 1, y = forward_reads + 1)) +
    geom_point(
        aes(color = strandedness, size = prevalence_n, alpha = strandedness)
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = strand_alpha) +
    scale_color_manual(values = stand_colors) +
    coord_fixed() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(y="Total Forward Reads + 1", x="Total Reverse Reads + 1") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=3))) +
    theme_bw()

ggsave(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "fwd-rev-counts_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    p_fwdrev_spread,
    width = 10, height = 8
)

dt_r1_r2_delta <- fwd_rev_stats %>%
    mutate(r1r2_delta = forward_reads - reverse_reads) %>%
    filter(abs(r1r2_delta) > 1000) %>% 
    DT::datatable()

saveRDS(
    dt_r1_r2_delta,
    glue("{palm_interim}/fwd_rev_stats_delta_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
)

```

Calculating R1/R2 read correlation for each virus id

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Function to calculate Pearson correlation for each virus_id
calculate_correlation <- function(virus_data) {
    cor_result <- stats::cor(
        virus_data$forward_reads,
        virus_data$reverse_reads,
        method = "pearson"
    )
    cor_result_rank <- stats::cor(
        virus_data$forward_reads,
        virus_data$reverse_reads,
        method = "spearman"
    )
    tibble(
        pearson_correlation = cor_result,
        spearman_correlation = cor_result_rank
    )
}

# Parallel setup
future::plan("multisession", workers = 24)

# Calculate correlations in parallel
read_direction_cor <- palm_res %>%
    group_by(virus_ids) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(correlation = furrr::future_map(data, calculate_correlation)) %>%
    unnest(correlation) %>%
    mutate(max_vals = furrr::future_map(data, ~ {{ tibble(
        fwd_max = max(.$forward_reads),
        rev_max = max(.$reverse_reads),
        total_max = max(c(fwd_max, rev_max)),
        prevalence_n = length(.$sample_id)
    ) }})) %>%
    unnest(max_vals)

read_direction_cor %>% glimpse()

saveRDS(
    read_direction_cor,
    glue(
        "{palm_interim}/",
        "fwd-rev-count-correlations_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

```


```{r, eval=FALSE}

    filter(total_max > 10) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = "all viruses", x = pearson_correlation)) +

    geom_point(
        aes(size = prevalence_n),
        alpha = 0.2, position = position_jitter()) +
    geom_xsidedensity(aes(y = after_stat(density))) +

        labs(y = NULL, x = "R1/R2 Pearson Correlation") +
        theme_light() +
        theme(
            ggside.panel.scale = .3,
            axis.text.y = element_blank()
        )

ggsave(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "correlation_boxplot_{Sys.Date()}.png"

    p_corr,
    width = 8, height = 3
)
```

### Creating a phyloseq object from PalmDB results

Summing forward and reverse reads for each virus id and generating a phyloseq object

```{r, eval=FALSE}

count_df <- palm_res %>%
    mutate(count = forward_reads + reverse_reads) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(forward_reads, reverse_reads)) %>%
    as.data.table() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = virus_ids,
        values_from = count,
        values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    glimpse()

saveRDS(
    count_df,
    glue(
        "{palm_interim}/",
        "count-matrix_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
    )
)

# read in metadata
metadata_df <- readRDS(
    glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/metadata/2023-07-14_phyloseq-metadata.rds")
)$RNASEQ

# saving a phyloseq object from PalmDB results
sotu <- count_df %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id") %>%
    t() %>%
    otu_table(., taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

# formatting metadata
ps_meta <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% colnames(sotu)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    glimpse()
rownames(ps_meta) <- ps_meta$sample_id
ps_meta <- phyloseq::sample_data(ps_meta)
ps_taxtable <- palm_meta %>%
    mutate_all(
        ~ gsub("\\.", "", .) %>% tolower()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-strandedness) %>%
    column_to_rownames("rep_ID") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    phyloseq::tax_table()

# assemble phyloseq object
ps <- phyloseq(sotu, ps_meta, ps_taxtable)

saveRDS(
  ps,
  glue(
    "{palm_interim}/",
    "phyloseq_count_matrix_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna_{Sys.Date()}.rds"
  )
)

```
